expectedTruths: Each cell was deleted independently with probability 0.08 (MCAR). Rows: 500; complete rows: 258; missing cells per column: v1=42, v2=39, v3=37, v4=34, v5=45, v6=40, v7=38, v8=31; total missing cells: 306.
Listwise deletion must use exactly 258 rows (sample.nUsed = 258, nDropped = 242).

FIML must use all 500 rows and requires a mean structure. A configuration requesting FIML where the capability registry does not support it for (method, engine, estimator) is a validation error, never a silent fallback to listwise.
Under MCAR both listwise and FIML are consistent; their estimates differ in finite samples and are not asserted equal.
Population as cfa-two-factor (standardised loadings .80,.75,.70,.65 / .85,.80,.75,.70; factor correlation 0.40), drawn with this case's own seed.
purpose: Missing-data variants: listwise vs compatible FIML rules
